notes.title: Update 1.2.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! "W.O.L.F" has been updated to version 1.2.1!

 Two new achievements have been added.
  "Speedrun" - Reached the ending within 2 hours.
  "Minimum number of mistakes" - The number of misses reached the ending within 300.
 Minor bugs have been corrected.

notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
"W.O.L.F" has been updated to version 1.2.0!

This update adds a stage select function!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283334/79ff379eda10e609b94a53f06643c59237597c40.png
It is available from the menu screen after clearing the game.
Use it to retrieve gear you missed or to practice on a stage you are having difficulty with!

【Notes and Apologies】

 Changes to the game structure are unavoidable and as a result, the number of gears acquired prior to version 1.1.1 will be initialized. I sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. (Gear acquired after version 1.2.0 will be recorded normally.)
 To open the stage select function, you must view the ending once. If you have already cleared the game, please view the ending again from "Continue Game" on the menu screen.
 The stage select function is only available when the game has been cleared and save data exists. Please note that if you start a new game from the beginning, the stage select function will not be available until you reach the ending again.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
"W.O.L.F" has been updated to version 1.1.0!

In this update, I have added a new feature that allows you to skip the room you are challenging and move on to the next room if you have made many mistakes (over 100) in the room you are currently challenging!

Please use this function when you really want to move on! However, please note that once you use the skip function, you will not be able to go back to the previous room.

The skip function can be used from the pause screen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283334/6f838da0102582120dd5f89e45573dc91d62260b.png
